sentences.en: There was something horrible and bestial in the fleeting glance they threw at the riders and in the malevolent expression with which, after a glance at Kutuzov, the soldier with the sores immediately turned away and went on with what he was doing.

sentences.en: St. Joan's wort oil stops cold sores in their tracks and can even relieve genital herpes symptoms.

sentences.en: The major, and most painful conditions include bunions, blisters and sores, ingrown toenails, cracks and fungus.
